title: HCI Says Hurricane Isaias Will Affect One Tokenized Reinsurance Security
why_it_matters: The update shows how an insured catastrophe can flow through a live tokenized reinsurance structure, turning blockchain-based risk participation into a measurable loss-bearing instrument rather than a conceptual pilot.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

HCI Says Hurricane Isaias Will Affect One Tokenized Reinsurance Security

HCI expects its Token B reinsurance security and one of three reinsurance towers to absorb effects from Hurricane Isaias, while saying the token remains profitable.
